# Agents

Run the tests before a commit.

If a task edits code or docs, run `spec-dna context <files>` once. Before a commit, run `spec-dna check`. Rules: test first (tdd), cause first (debug), proof before done (verify), review is data (review), isolated work (execute). Detail: `spec-dna skill show <name>`. An agent writes an approval commit only when the owner says so explicitly in the chat.<!-- spec-dna v0.7.1 h:b9b4ed5ebfbbd534 -->
